messages:
sara: Quick proposal — for the v2 rollout I want to combine a small A/B slice with a shadow path and a "lag budget" circuit breaker per region. Reason: we can evaluate user-facing quality while bounding tail-latency impact.

sara: Rough flow: 1) 1% A/B (control vs v2) for quality metrics, 2) 5% shadow (v2 receives traffic but not counted for user responses) to measure perf & KV cache behavior, 3) open up traffic in staged regional windows with a lag-budget circuit-breaker.

devon: +1. can you define lag budget?

sara: Lag budget = allowed cumulative additional p99 latency (ms*requests) over baseline in a rolling window. If budget is consumed, circuit breaker trips to fallback model or reduced batch size. Keeps user-visible latency bounded.

prateek: Sounds good. Do we have telemetry for that today? p99 token latency per-region + request rate should be enough. also want memory/KV miss delta from shadow.

sara: Yes, Console has per-route p50/p95/p99 and "kv-miss-rate" metric. We'll add a derived "lag_budget_consumed" metric.

lisa: What's the threshold for trips? And what fallback do we pick? degrade to quantized v2? fallback to v1?

sara: Proposal: primary fallback is v1 (golden) for correctness. If v1 not available, fallback to a low-latency quantized v2 that we pre-warm. Tiered: 1) v1 2) v2-quantized 3) empty-response with error label (last resort).

devon: How about fast rollback? Do we want a kill-switch?

sara: Yes: flag + automatic kill-switch. If lag_budget_consumed>100% for 3 consecutive 1m windows, auto-disable rollout flag for that region and send alert. Manual override allowed via console.

prateek: For AB quality gating: what metrics? perplexity/emt? we should pick three: intent-match (from eval set), response-quality scoring (human or eval model), and error-rate.

sara: Agreed. AB gate opens to next stage only if: intent-match delta >= -1%, response-quality delta >= -2%, error-rate delta <= +0.25%. Also regression alert if any metric drifts > threshold.

lisa: Customer asks: enterprise customers want a greenlist opt-out so they don't see v2 at all. Is that supported?

sara: Yes, we'll add holdout by tenant id. rollout flag supports include/exclude lists per-tenant. Default include is everyone in slice, but we can pin enterprise tenants to control-plane "holdout".

devon: Need rollout windows scheduling per-region to avoid global peaks. Suggest windows: EU morning, NA afternoon, APAC overnight relative to local peaks.

sara: We'll schedule 3-hour windows per region. Also add a "surge buffer" that keeps max additional qps at +10% of baseline during window. If utilization > baseline+10% then pause ingress and rely on shadow-only.

prateek: Can we show a sample flag config?

sara: Here is a minimal example to implement in FF service:

```json
{
  "flag": "v2_rollout",
  "slices": [
    {"name":"ab1","pct":1},
    {"name":"shadow_fast","shadow_pct":5}
  ],
  "per_region_windows": {"us-west": "2024-05-03T15:00Z/3h", "eu": "2024-05-03T07:00Z/3h"},
  "lag_budget_ms_req": 500000,
  "fallback_order": ["v1","v2-quantized"],
  "kill_switch": {"consecutive_windows":3, "threshold_pct":100}
}
```

lisa: Nice. Who owns the derived metric and alarm? Alerts team or infra?

sara: Observability will own the metric derivation; alerts owned by eng-sre; runbooks written by Eng/Prod.

devon: How do we validate KV cache behavior in shadow? are we logging cache evictions?

prateek: Add a custom histogram for shadow_kv_miss_latency and shadow_kv_evictions per-minute. We'll instrument runtime to emit those.

lisa: Launch criteria checklist from me: 1) AB quality gates green 2) shadow perf within 10% p95 3) lag_budget model validated in synthetic load 4) runbook + rollback tested 5) enterprise holdouts configurable 6) rollout windows scheduled

sara: I'll populate a checklist doc, but trying to keep the rollout thread tight here.

deploy-bot: deployment queued for canary-2024-05-03T15:00Z -> job#4521. :rocket:

devon: timeline: aiming to start AB & shadow next week (2024-05-03). If all green, staged region open after 48h. Any objections?

lisa: none from me. please add me to runbook review.

prateek: I'll add the metric dashboards and a simple smoke test that runs every 5m in shadow and AB slices.

sara: Perfect — I'll update the flag config, link the runbook, and create the rollout PR. Thanks! :thumbsup:
